title: FairDeDup: Detecting and Mitigating Vision-Language Fairness Disparities in Semantic Dataset Deduplication

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using zero-shot image classification disparity between masculine and feminine presentation on the FACET dataset, and evaluated using text-image retrieval skew metrics (MaxSkew@k, MinSkew@k, NDKL) on the FairFace dataset.

Assessed via zero-shot classification disparity on the FACET dataset using the Monk Skin Tone (MST) scale (lighter vs. darker skin tones), and evaluated using text-image retrieval skew metrics across seven racial groups on the FairFace dataset.

Evaluated by measuring zero-shot classification disparity between age groups (younger, middle-aged, older) on the FACET dataset, and computing text-image retrieval skew metrics across age bins on the FairFace dataset.
